name: FreightQuoteBuilder
tagline: Rate, price, approve and send LTL and FTL freight quotes in minutes – and learn from every quote you lose – in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete freight sales quoting desk for brokers, 3PLs and carrier sales teams: a rating engine with LTL weight breaks, freight class, deficit weight and minimums and FTL rates per mile by equipment, discounts, fuel surcharge and an accessorial catalogue, carrier cost and margin with pricing from cost, approval rules for low margins, big quotes and discounts, a quote email with the price breakdown, validity and follow-ups, versions and revisions, won / lost with competitor prices, a dashboard, pipeline board and lane analysis. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: LTL rating: weight breaks, freight class, distance factor, deficit weight, minimum charge
FTL rating: rate per mile by equipment, minimum, manual spot linehaul
Discount, fuel surcharge and accessorial catalogue
Carrier cost, margin gauge and Price at target margin
Approval rules: minimum margin, max rep discount, value threshold
Quote and follow-up emails from a template → Power Fx / Outlook
Validity, follow-up flags, extend and expire
Won with carrier and final cost, lost with reason and competitor price
Bulk assign, follow-ups, expire, lost + undo
Keyboard and phone layout with bottom bar
QuotesCsv and SummaryJson for Teams / email / Power BI flows
Demo mode with fictional sample data
controlType: standard (2 controls: niray_Niray.FreightQuoteBuilder data-set + niray_Niray.FreightQuoteBuilderPortal field control)
